_comment: The slide designs. This folder is where they live and where they are read from: the app uses these files, not the copies in PocketBase, so nothing typed into an admin UI can break them. To add a design, drop the .html in beside this file and add an entry here. An .html with no entry still works, but writes its own name and gets a generic category.
_category_note: category is not a label. It is the sentence the model reads to decide which design suits a post, so write it as a description of what the design is good for.

designs.category: Clean, flat and editorial. The default for step by step walkthroughs, workflow breakdowns and anything instructional where the words carry the whole slide.
Near black with drifting smoke. Use for myth busting, hard truths, contrarian takes and posts meant to stop the scroll with a bold claim.
White with pale smoke. Suits tool stacks, technical architecture, product teardowns and anything that benefits from a light, airy, spacious feel.
Warm flat beige. Best for business outcomes, before and after transformations, client results and growth stories aimed at a commercial reader.
Heavy grey smoke with depth. Use for mistakes to avoid, risk and warning posts, and anything with a serious or cautionary tone.

Black fading to warm grey, with a photograph of the author filling the first and last slides. Use for personal takes, opinion pieces, lessons learned and anything told in the first person, where the face is the reason someone stops scrolling.

_requires_note: requires names images from templates/assets that a design cannot render without, by filename without the extension. A design listing one that is not there is left out of the picker rather than rendered with an empty frame.
